customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile

name.meaning: customer's full name as written on the signed agreement

phone_number.meaning: primary phone number on the profile

email.meaning: email address on the profile, lower case

service_address.meaning: street address of the home where the work is done (one service address per profile)

service_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the service address

date_of_birth.meaning: customer's date of birth as recorded at the first contract or credit application

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the customer profile was created

home_year_built.meaning: year the home at the service address was built, from the property record taken at the in-home consultation

occupancy_type.meaning: how the home at the service address is used: lived in by the owner, or rented out

window_contract_id.meaning: primary id of the window contract

variant_name.meaning: the product series held, written as its official full name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the holding (lifecycle.states of the window charter)

contract_number.meaning: contract number printed on the signed agreement; the customer can read it off their copy

sales_channel.meaning: where the sale was made: at the customer's home, in a Ridgeline showroom, or by video consultation

opening_count.meaning: number of openings on the contract (updated at the final measure)

contract_price.meaning: signed contract price after any discount program, including options chosen at signing; changes later only through a series change

payment_method.meaning: how the contract is paid: by the customer directly, or through a Ridgeline financing account

discount_program.meaning: the single discount program applied at signing, or none

warranty_plan.meaning: the warranty plan chosen at signing, as its official name; it becomes the plan of the warranty registration at installation completion

measure_date.meaning: date of the completed final measure; empty until measured

order_release_date.meaning: date the order was released to the factory; empty until released

completion_date.meaning: date the installation was completed; empty until installed

cancelled_date.meaning: date the written cancellation notice was given; empty unless cancelled

closed_date.meaning: date the contract was closed after being paid in full; empty while open

window_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the window contract transaction

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the charter

txn_date.meaning: date of the payment, refund, change order, credit, fee or appointment

amount.meaning: amount of the money movement as a positive magnitude; the event type says whether it adds to or reduces the account; 0.00 for an appointment

payment_kind.meaning: what a payment is for; not_applicable on other rows

tender_type.meaning: how a payment was made; not_applicable on other rows

refund_kind.meaning: why a refund was issued; not_applicable on other rows

source_window_txn_id.meaning: for a refund, the payment record the money is returned from; empty on other rows

change_kind.meaning: what a change-order line adds; not_applicable on other rows

credit_kind.meaning: why a price credit was granted; not_applicable on other rows

fee_kind.meaning: which fee was assessed; not_applicable on other rows

openings_affected.meaning: openings a change-order line prices, openings removed for a removal credit, or openings measured at a completed visit; 0 otherwise

visit_kind.meaning: kind of measure appointment: the final measure, a customer-requested remeasure, or a remeasure ordered by Ridgeline; not_applicable on other rows

visit_outcome.meaning: outcome of a measure appointment; not_applicable on other rows

oversize_opening_count.meaning: openings measured above the series' standard united-inch bracket at a completed visit; 0 otherwise

factory_order_id.meaning: for an on_time_guarantee_credit, the factory order whose late shipment earned it (-> factory_orders); empty otherwise

referred_contract_number.meaning: for a referral_credit, the contract number of the referred household's Ridgeline contract, exactly as printed; empty otherwise

window_cancel_request_id.meaning: primary id of the window contract cancellation request

notice_date.meaning: date the written notice of cancellation was given or postmarked

notice_method.meaning: how the written notice was given

request_status.meaning: status of the request: received when recorded, processed once the cancellation is settled, withdrawn if the customer retracts it before processing

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
